chunks: That We bore their progeny in the laden ark is a sign for them;
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Ark in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Dhurriyyah al-Mustafa* (the Chosen Descendants), specifically the progeny of Nuh who preserved the monotheistic lineage leading to the Prophet Muhammad and the Ahl al-Bayt. The 'heavily loaded' (*al-mashhun*) ark symbolizes the weight of divine trust and the preservation of faith amidst the corruption of the time, serving as a precursor to the ultimate salvation found in the Imams.
